summary: Iteration 19 backend + frontend testing complete for Fashion Manufacturing (Liniar) app new features: POS channel + payment_method, 5-role granular RBAC, CSV import, per-channel stock allocation. All 28 backend pytest cases passed (100%). Frontend menu filtering verified for all 4 new roles with exact match. POS UI checkout with QRIS + receipt printing works end-to-end. Import CSV UI processes valid + invalid rows correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 74-line file but each line is extremely long (>7000 chars each). File is essentially minified inline JSX - very hard to review, maintain, or diff. Strongly recommend splitting into per-component files (POSKasir.jsx, ImportCSV.jsx, Inventory.jsx, KasBank.jsx, etc.) and running prettier. This is the #1 maintainability risk.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' in backend/.env combined with allow_credentials will fail in strict browsers; only works today because CORS middleware is not actively enforced from the given file (need to verify). Should be explicit origin list for production.

sales/import-csv uses current_user (any authenticated role) — intentional per spec note, but staf_gudang/kasir could import for arbitrary channels. Consider restricting to admin/admin_keuangan or logging channel for audit.

POS default price heuristic (value/stock * 1.6 rounded to nearest 1000, fallback 100000) is fragile — a barang jadi with zero value would default to Rp 100.000. Consider persisting an explicit list price on inventory.
test_credentials: All 6 demo accounts verified working: admin@liniar.id/Liniar123!, keuangan@liniar.id/Keuangan123!, produksi@liniar.id/Produksi123!, kasir@liniar.id/Kasir123!, gudang@liniar.id/Gudang123!, staff@liniar.id/Staff123!
seed_data_creation: Consumed 2 units of LIN-OVR-001 via POS + CSV import (TEST_ prefixed customers). Set channel_stock allocations on a barang jadi. No cleanup performed as data is demo-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter19 adds POS channel (channel='POS' allowed in /api/sales and /api/ledger valid_channels). 4 new roles seeded: admin_keuangan, manajer_produksi, kasir, staf_gudang. admin_only accepts only {admin, owner} — admin_keuangan intentionally gets 403 on kas-movements/assets/receivables-payables/reports/ledger (by design; frontend just hides menu). New endpoints: POST /api/sales/import-csv?channel=X (multipart, any authenticated user), POST /api/inventory/{sku}/allocate (barang jadi only, 6 valid channels). Frontend has testids: pos-*, import-*, alloc-* — all verified working.
